maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring payment processing fees and banking services on transaction volume, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Merchant processing, commercial payables and banking customers are private businesses, ISOs and fintechs paying fees from consumer and business transactions.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by adding merchants (about 3.7K per month) and products; acquisitions occur but aren't the main growth route.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded payment processing, MX Merchant POS, payables and banking-as-a-service are integrated into customers' operations, so switching means re-integration and disruption.

notes: Serial-acquirer answer is a judgment call; the company has made acquisitions historically, but the website emphasises organic merchant growth.
